name: Indicative reference figures, 2023
note: NOT OFFICIAL DATA. Approximate nominal GDP and mid-year population for 2023, entered by hand so the insights pages have something to show and so a new compilation can be sanity-checked for order of magnitude. They are close to the published series but are not the published series, and no figure here should be quoted, cited or used in an analysis that leaves this application. Replace them with the official file before relying on any comparison: scripts/load-benchmarks.mjs pulls the World Bank indicators NY.GDP.MKTP.CD and SP.POP.TOTL and flips verified to true. See DECISIONS.md D51.
